notes.title: The Future
notes.content:
After receiving your feedback I have decided on a path forward. I will do events every other month with new story, monsters and achievements. We may return to stories from time to time but some stories and achievements may never be seen again! I will try and get the next event ready for next month along with some little updates in the meantime.

Every 2 months or so, especially during season changes and for holidays and for a limited time I will run events that:


 Create a new story
 New enemies 
 New spells
 New backgrounds
 New achievements 

More about the next Ozric story coming so stay tuned in.

Fixed the trigger that you guys told me about.

Working on pausing narrative and adding more achievements 

Thank you guys so much for the support!
